description: This Java source file defines the PackageValidator class, which validates whether a calling package is authorized to access a MediaBrowserService based on its signing certificate and package name. It reads allowed callers from an XML resource and provides a method to check caller authorization.

classes.name: PackageValidator
classes.description: A class that validates if a calling package is authorized to access media browsing services based on its signing certificate and package name.

methods.name: PackageValidator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validator with allowed certificates from XML resource.

methods.name: readValidCertificates
methods.description: Reads and parses the XML resource to build a map of valid signing certificates to caller info.

methods.name: isCallerAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a caller identified by package name and UID is authorized based on its signature and package name.
